headline: EU puts ChatGPT under the DSA's strictest tier; Gatekeeper jumps
body: A bright day for coordination. The European Commission designated ChatGPT a Very Large Online Search Engine under the Digital Services Act, requiring systemic-risk assessments, mitigation and researcher data access within four months. Binding cross-border oversight raises Global Coordination and Alignment & Control, which lifts Gatekeeper (nations keeping a lid on runaway AI) and Protector God, and pulls Self-Destruction and Conquerors down. Eight smaller items, many from lower-credibility sources, barely moved things: data-centre protests, Meta's child-safety settlement and NHS AI-scribe errors added Tech Backlash; Andrew Bailey warned the G20 about AI cyber risk. Horizon Balance rose to -2.33, the best reading in a week.
movers_note: Gatekeeper +0.4, from the EU's DSA designation of ChatGPT (+0.44), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.03) and smaller items (-0.02). Self-Destruction -0.3, from the EU's DSA designation of ChatGPT (-0.31), partly offset by Bailey's G20 cyber warning (+0.04) and smaller items (+0.02). Conquerors -0.2, mostly from the EU's DSA designation of ChatGPT (-0.16) and fading earlier news (-0.05).
coming_up: ChatGPT must deliver DSA systemic-risk assessments, mitigation and researcher data access within four months
